name: The Loop
source:
A boy gets gets caught by hooligans and awakens in the classroom. He sees a gift box with a note describing five rules. When he looks out of the window, he sees a blonde girl getting shot dead while trying to escape through the front door. A pink haired girl appears before him and asks to find the murderer.  

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
